comparison.objective: Cut a PCB lead flush while capturing and disposing of the offcut.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-tip alignment, bimanual offcut control, cutting, and small-part transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Lead is clipped flush and the offcut reaches the scrap cup without loss or damage.
comparison.reason: Precision cutting and fragment capture do not exercise long-part leveling or multi-stage load-bearing rack attachment.
